mutations.name: a still button's hint offers new text before the hold
mutations.find: ${full ?? "first hold it with heldS, which adds no words"}
kills: the Q-D22 hint for a still closing button leads with a hold that adds no words and names the label and frame caps on every move that adds text

mutations.name: a still button's new line names no caps
mutations.find: (its reading time is not still time) ${WITHIN_CAPS}
mutations.replace: (its reading time is not still time)
kills: the Q-D22 hint for a still closing button leads with a hold that adds no words and names the label and frame caps on every move that adds text

mutations.name: an added item names no caps
mutations.find: so add the item ${WITHIN_CAPS}, or split the beat
mutations.replace: so add the item or split the beat
kills: the Q-D22 hint for a still closing button names the caps on adding an item to a cued kind

mutations.name: the Q-D20 hint never names the button's hold
kills: the Q-D20 hint for a closing button names the hold, so a shorter label does not leave the button still

mutations.name: the hint offers a hold with the held band full
kills: the Q-D22 hint for a still closing button with the held band full leads with a line the voice does not read, not a hold
the Q-D20 hint for a closing button with the held band full, asks for words the voice does not read in place of a hold
